TITLE: LockByte App
DESCRIPTION:
In my first year, I had the incredible opportunity to present LockByte at my college's 7th International Conference. *LockByte* is a powerful encryption and decryption application designed to securely protect files, including videos, images, text documents, and Word files.
🔒 *Key Features:*
✅ *AES Encryption:* Uses the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) for robust security.
✅ *Multi-Format Support:* Encrypts and decrypts various file types, ensuring broad usability.
✅ *User-Friendly Interface:* Designed for ease of use while maintaining strong security standards.
*LockByte* ensures that sensitive information remains confidential, making it a reliable tool for anyone looking to enhance digital security.
